notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
Added achievements! There are 21 of them, have fun completing them!

Core changes:


 Fixed an issue where the mini-games count per game was set to 2 by default.
 Renamed a bunch of mini-games to silly names with terrible puns (i’m sorry in advance)


Mini-games


 Lemon Squeezy (formerly Spilled): now evaluates ties between players.
 Sliberry Slope (formerly Slalom): reworked physics and collisions, pushing players is now more responsive.
 Bananas Foster (formerly Volcano) : fixed an issue where a player was floating above ground level.
 Peach Volley: more permissive on the timing, reworked difficulty curve to account for that.
 Fruit Basket : fixed weird bounce physics.
 Juice-Box (formerly Punching Bag): fixed emote animation not playing.
 Musical Pears (formerly Musical Chairs): fixed run animation not playing after an emote sometimes.

As always, keep letting me know if you encounter issues in the discussion threads!

Cheers,
pataya

notes.title: January 2025 patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
First of all, thank you for all the kind comments and positive reviews on the game! It was lovely seeing your messages sharing the positive experiences you had with your families and friends over the end of the year.

Here is a first patch addressing some of the main bugs/issues. Keep those bug reports coming in the Steam discussion threads, they are all very helpful!

There are a few more updates planned, with a focus on quality of life and improving design issues in some mini-games (looking at you, Fruit Basket!).

Here’s a list of the most notable improvements for this current patch.
Wishing you a happy new year!

pataya 

Miscellaneous


 Fixed the crash occurring in the Mini-games selection menu.
 Enabled the option to play all 20 mini-games in a single game.
 Added an option to turn VSync on or off in the graphics settings.


The Blender


 Reworked the difficulty curve to increase the pacing a little.
 The resolution animation now plays increasingly faster for the same purpose.


Mini-golf


 Fixed an issue where a hammer was hiding the final hole.


Punching bag


 Fixed an issue where the HUD for the amount of impulses left would not appear properly.


Hurdle race


 Performance improvements
